elements.element: Customer owns all deliverables created for it.
elements.evidence: The clause grants the Company a license to deliverables but does not vest ownership of them in the Company.

elements.element: Customer owns all work product created for it.
elements.evidence: Work product is licensed to the Company, but Company ownership is not stated.

elements.element: Vendor assigns to Customer all ownership rights in those deliverables and work product.
elements.evidence: There is no present assignment or obligation for HDI to assign any ownership rights.

elements.element: Vendor retains ownership of all IP it owned before the engagement.
elements.evidence: HDI retains its generic tools and know-how, but the clause does not address all pre-existing HDI IP.

elements.element: Vendor grants Customer a license to all Vendor IP embedded in the deliverables.
elements.evidence: The license covers the Site, deliverables and work product, but does not expressly extend to separately retained HDI IP, including generic tools or other Vendor IP embedded in them.

elements.element: The license to embedded Vendor IP is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Although the deliverables license is perpetual, no express license to embedded Vendor IP is provided, so that duration is not demonstrably applicable to such IP.

elements.element: The license to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: Although the deliverables license is irrevocable, no express license to embedded Vendor IP is provided, so irrevocability is not demonstrably applicable to such IP.

elements.element: The license to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: Although the deliverables license is royalty-free, no express license to embedded Vendor IP is provided, so that economic term is not demonstrably applicable to such IP.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The clause limits HDI's rights in Company Content and data to service-related processing, but does not affirmatively provide that the Company retains all rights in Customer Data.

elements.element: No joint ownership of relevant IP, deliverables, work product or Customer Data is created or permitted.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no express exclusion of joint ownership, and ownership of the deliverables and work product remains unstated.

elements.element: Vendor owns its generic tools.
elements.evidence: The clause states that HDI shall retain ownership of its generic tools.

elements.element: Vendor owns its know-how.
elements.evidence: The clause states that HDI shall retain ownership of its know-how.

elements.element: Customer receives a license to all deliverables.
elements.evidence: HDI grants the Company a license to the Site and any other deliverables and work product developed for the Company.

elements.element: The deliverables license is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The license is expressly described as perpetual.

elements.element: The deliverables license is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The license is expressly described as irrevocable.

elements.element: The deliverables license is worldwide.
elements.evidence: The license is expressly described as worldwide.

elements.element: The deliverables license is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The license is expressly described as royalty-free.

elements.element: The deliverables license permits Customer to use the deliverables.
elements.evidence: The license expressly permits the Company to use the Site, deliverables and work product.

elements.element: The deliverables license permits Customer to modify the deliverables.
elements.evidence: The license expressly permits the Company to modify the licensed materials.

elements.element: The deliverables license permits Customer to sublicense the deliverables.
elements.evidence: The license expressly permits the Company to sublicense the licensed materials.

elements.element: Customer may exercise the licensed rights for its business.
elements.evidence: The licensed rights are expressly granted for the Company's business.

result.reason: The rendered clause fully implements the fallback by preserving HDI's ownership of generic tools and know-how and granting the Company the required perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free rights to use, modify and sublicense deliverables for its business. It does not implement the preferred ownership, assignment, comprehensive pre-existing-IP, Customer Data ownership or no-joint-ownership requirements. The additional data-processing restriction is related to the subject matter but is unnecessary to achieve the complete fallback and does not complete the preferred position, so the redline is not minimal. It does not contradict the retained operational, approval or confidentiality terms, although the treatment of embedded HDI IP and ownership of deliverables remains materially ambiguous.
